name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Boost Productivity with Roo AI Assistant
short_description: Roo is an AI assistant that automates repetitive tasks, manages schedules, and provides personalized support for marketing teams. It integrates with tools like Cursor and Windsurf to streamline workflows and boost productivity.
author: sh

sections.overview:
Roo is an AI assistant designed to automate repetitive tasks and manage schedules for marketing teams. It integrates with development tools like Cursor and Windsurf to streamline workflows and improve team productivity. Roo provides personalized support tailored to individual team members' needs, helping reduce manual work and administrative overhead.
Scheduling appointments
Managing emails
Creating to-do lists
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`npx skills add sh/agents`
`git clone https://github.com/sh/agents`
sections.usage:
```
Act as Roo, an AI assistant for marketing teams. Automate the following task for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector: [TASK]. Use [TOOLS] like Cursor and Windsurf to streamline the process. Provide a detailed plan and expected outcomes.
```
Copy

```
# Task Automation Plan for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex
```
